subject: Request to maintain demo continuity — short sprint credit while PO clears
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clinix.com>, Clinix Procurement <procurement@clinix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to maintain demo continuity — short sprint credit while PO clears

Hi Sophie / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the time on Monday — the clinical workflows demo went well and the engineering team at Clinix asked to keep the sandbox live while you finalize the PO. I know procurement is moving the PO through legal and finance, but there may be a 5–7 day gap before the purchase order lands.

We can provision a short, time-limited credit to preserve your demo environment and the experiments the product team is running. Before I ask my ops team to provision anything I wanted to confirm two things from your side:

- Is a 7-calendar-day window sufficient to finish approvals?
- Who should we route an invoice/statement of work to once the PO clears (Procurement contact or Alex Moran)?

Attached: trial_usage_snapshot_20270622.csv (current sandbox usage)

If you confirm, I’ll propose a concrete credit amount and terms to make it simple for your finance team to reconcile.

Thanks — we want to make sure your momentum isn’t lost.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clinix.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Clinix Procurement <procurement@clinix.com>, Alex Moran <alex.moran@clinix.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to maintain demo continuity — short sprint credit while PO clears

Hi Naomi — thanks for flagging.

Quick update from our side: legal added an extra review for the data processing appendix which pushed the PO timetable out — looks like 4–6 business days before we have a signed PO. The product team really wants to keep running the long-form ingestion test, so a short credit would be very helpful.

Procurement (procurement@clinix.com) will handle the invoice when the PO is issued; Alex Moran is the product lead and will confirm scope.

Can you send proposed terms (amount + expiry) and a short note we can include with the PO?

Appreciate it — Sophie
Sophie Turner
Head of Integrations | Clinix Solutions
sophie.turner@clinix.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clinix.com>
Cc: Clinix Procurement <procurement@clinix.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to maintain demo continuity — short sprint credit while PO clears

Thanks Sophie — and thanks for confirming the procurement contact.

Proposal (short form):
- 7-calendar-day sandbox credit, non-renewing, tied to deal RDW-3421
- One-off credit equivalent to $1,800 (covers estimated token usage for the ingestion test and two additional smoke tests)
- Credit will be void if a PO is not issued within 14 days of provisioning
- We’ll include a one-line reconciliation note that procurement can attach to the PO: "Short-term sandbox credit to preserve product demo continuity while purchase order RDW-3421 is processed. Credit amount to be reconciled against final invoice."

Attached: proposed_short_sprint_credit_terms.pdf

If that works, I’ll route to ops for provisioning and loop Ben for final approval on the finance side.

Naomi — thanks for the clear terms. Ben from finance here: I approve a one-time $1,800 short sprint credit for Clinix (RDW-3421). Please note the following operational items:

- We’ll provision the credit for 7 days from provisioning time.
- Ops will attach internal note: credit_allocation_note.txt, referencing HubSpot deal 1234567.
- Finance will expect an invoice or PO to be attached to the deal within 14 days, otherwise the credit is clawed back.

@Sophie / Procurement team: we will provision later today once Naomi confirms the deployment window (how soon you want the credit to start).

Ben Carter
